subtopic: Brokers, Investment Advisers, and Financial Planners
source_evidence: You can hire a broker, an investment adviser, or a financial planner to help you make investment decisions.
answer: Brokers, investment advisers, and financial planners are among the professionals you can hire to help with investment decisions. Their services and prices can vary, so compare options and ask what services are offered and how the professional is paid. If a fee is quoted as a percentage, ask what that means in dollars. Don’t assume that initials or a professional title automatically mean someone is more qualified or will provide better service.
